breaking_news.why_notable: Death of major political figure who embodied institutional collapse and accountability gap; significant symbolic moment for accountability discourse in politics.

breaking_news.title: U.S. B-1 bombers evacuated from UK base after attack threats from Iran
breaking_news.summary: Pentagon evacuated a dozen B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford airbase in the UK over the weekend following reports of Iranian attack threats against the base.

breaking_news.title: Denmark Data Breach Exposes 8.8M People's Personal Data
